newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end down over U.S.-Irag tensions.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end down over U.S.-Irag tensions.

text.p: Taiwan share prices ended lower on Tuesday as selling intensified in late trade on growing fears of mounting tension between the United States and Iraq, brokers said.
The weighted index closed down 84.20 points or 1.33 percent at 6,257.97. Turnover was T$37.36 billion.
"Fears of war in Iraq triggered widespread selling in late trade," said Eric Liu of National Securities.
Investors were worried about potential rises in oil prices if a war broke out, brokers said.
